# Danny Namnum — UX & Website Designer

## About
Danny Namnum is a UX and website designer specializing in real estate websites, interactive kiosks, and lead conversion optimization. Based in South Florida, working with clients nationwide. Stanford AI UX Certified. 15+ years experience.

## Services
- Real Estate Website Design (brokerages, builders, master-planned communities)
- Interactive Kiosk Design (casino, hospitality, real estate sales centers)
- Lead Conversion Optimization
- Mobile-First UX Design
- Hospitality Digital Experience Design
- SaaS/App Design

## Notable Clients
- Babcock Ranch (solar-powered master-planned community, full website rebuild, 80% of traffic was mobile)
- PENN Entertainment (casino floor kiosk redesign across 43 properties, 7 usability fixes from in-person observation)
- GL Homes (sales center kiosk that reduced buyer decision time by 60%)
- Payology (SaaS fintech app design)

## Industries
- Real Estate (brokerages, home builders, master-planned communities)
- Hospitality (casinos, hotels, resorts)
- SaaS / Fintech
